text:
maya (packaging): quick heads-up — assembling sealed bundle for ACME VPC customer. planning to push artifact to staging and kick the canary at 17:30 UTC. tag: private-installer-1.12.3. need cosign + KMS verifier check before we flip the transport.

alex (infra): ack. I pushed the image to private-registry with tag private-installer-1.12.3. checksum: sha256:3f4b2c9d...f9a2

toni (ops): copying checksums to signer queue now. cosign signature scheduled at 17:05 UTC. can we keep a 30m hold window post-sign? want to catch any manifest drift. :eyes:

sam (sre): @maya on rollback triggers — if the canary error rate > 2% or deploybot reports >10s median startup, we abort and unpin to previous manifest. confirm?

maya (packaging): yep, rollback criteria agreed. also adding a note to release notes: 'private installer: servicemesh connector fix, offline bundle checksum support'.

deploy-bot: cosign signature complete for private-installer-1.12.3 by signer: kms-prod-02. signature: cosign:sha256:aa77...

deploy-bot: canary start scheduled at 17:30 UTC. initiating on groups: vpc-edge-1 (3 nodes), vpc-edge-2 (1 node). TTL: 30m. strategy: serial 3->1.

alex (infra): quick validation command for staging nodes if you want to sanity-check before canary:
```
ssh bundle-check@staging-1 -- 'curl -sS --fail http://127.0.0.1:8080/health | jq .status'
```

toni (ops): ran curl on staging-1: returned {"status":"ok"}. logs show startup lag ~2.1s. good.

maya (packaging): pushed release notes draft to the docs repo: docs/releases/private-installer-1.12.3.md — tagging @product for visibility.

sam (sre): deploy-bot reports canary progress: vpc-edge-1 node1 ok, node2 ok, node3 degraded (OOM @bootstrap). moving to rollback check.

deploy-bot: canary halted at 17:36 UTC due to node failure in vpc-edge-1 (OOM). initiating rollback plan: unpin manifest and promote previous tag private-installer-1.12.2 to active route. Notifying oncall.

toni (ops): starting immediate image pin rollback. re-deploying private-installer-1.12.2 to vpc-edge-1 node3. ETA ~4m.

alex (infra): tracing shows memory spike tied to connector preload. I'll open a quick hotfix branch, but agree to rollback first.

maya (packaging): ack — aborting rollout and marking 1.12.3 as quarantined. adding note: 'do not promote — investigation in progress'.

sam (sre): monitors back to normal after rollback. rolling metrics show median startup back to 1.9s. good. :white_check_mark:

maya (packaging): postmortem note: will re-run package build with reduced preload and re-test in perf lab before next attempt. scheduling a small deploy-window next Tue 14:00 UTC if ops + infra free.

deploy-bot: rollback complete at 17:42 UTC. route restored to private-installer-1.12.2.

toni (ops): thumbs up. will follow up with cosign signer to revoke 1.12.3 signature and update quarantine manifest.

maya (packaging): thanks team — logging this thread into the release ticket and will attach logs + diffs. :sparkles:
